history.description: Soft electric-blue light shafts and drifting haze fan across a near-black ground from the upper right, leaving the left side dark and calm.
A huge geometric 4 made of thick frosted glass, lit from inside and behind so its face glows white-blue, its edges shine and the light behind it bleeds softly through.
A thin neon horizon line with a hot white-blue core and a soft blue glow that spills onto the floor below it, drawing itself across the frame from the left.

Composite the tinted bloom back over the scene.

history.description: Softly fades the top and bottom of the scene to pure ink so it blends seamlessly into the page around it.

definitions.name: lit
definitions.description: Light-up progress, 0-1 (default 1). The landing sets it from scroll. 0: dark scene, only a faint stub of the neon line at the left edge. 0-0.4: the line draws itself left to right. ~0.35-0.85: the 4 lights up from inside (no flicker). 0.4-1: the light shafts and haze fade in, fully on at 1.
